projects.title: Theia
projects.summary: An upcoming Steam game and my first commercial title: an incremental planet-defense game I'm building solo in Unity 6, developed using my own framework.
description: Theia is my first commercial product and my entry into the incremental genre, built solo for Steam on Unity 6 (URP) and my own SpookyCore framework.

It is the first project where I've done every job myself: I built every system, from the architecture to gameplay and UI; designed the rules, progression, and numbers; and playtested each build, then rebalanced the game from the logged data.
contributions: **Built on [SpookyCore](spooky-core.html):** the game runs on my own Unity framework, which provides its foundation: an EventBus, a service locator, MVP UI, the Entity system (a custom MonoBehaviour lifecycle), a modifier-based Stat system, object pooling, and localization.

**Incremental progression:** in-run upgrade tracks for every satellite, a hexagonal meta upgrade tree with Core and Arsenal branches, currencies that carry over between runs, Star weapons unlocked by boss kills, and warping to later waves.

**Procedural content:** every run generates a new planet and a new backdrop in a light or dark color scheme, while adaptive music layers in stems that follow the fleet you build and the boss you face.

**Ship-ready features:** Steamworks integration, 33 achievements that sync both ways with Steam, seven languages with Google Sheets sync, full gamepad support, a first-run tutorial, and an in-game encyclopedia.
